items.title: Researchers Gain Access to StealC Malware Command-and-Control Systems
items.description: Security researchers successfully exploited vulnerabilities in the StealC malware infrastructure, gaining access to operator control panels and exposing a threat actor’s identity through their own stolen session cookies.
